responsibility: Implements RTL-aware CFG manipulation and the RTL/cfglayout `cfg_hooks` tables. It owns machine-instruction-chain updates that must accompany CFG edits, including insn deletion, block creation and splitting, edge redirection and forced non-fallthrough handling, edge-inserted insn commitment, dead-edge purging, abnormal-edge fixups, block duplication and movement, RTL CFG verification/dumping, cfglayout-specific block handling, and RTL-specific helpers used by generic loop versioning and profile accounting; generic CFG code calls into this file whenever structural edits must stay synchronized with RTL.
same_name_distinction: Contains the RTL-side implementation of CFG editing, including insn-chain synchronization and the RTL/cfglayout cfg_hooks tables that generic CFG code uses; cfgrtl.h only exposes those services.
